correctness.rationale: Desargues graph is the 20-vertex bipartite inclusion graph of 2- and 3-subsets of [5], 30 edges, group S5×C2 of order240 by recovering triangular distance-two graph and complement. Independent construction: 6212 faces incl empty with f=(1,20,160,660,1510,1924,1320,480,115,20,2), 3102 matched pairs, 1 critical vertex, one 4-cell, five 5-cells, full 30360 oriented Hasse incidences acyclic. Inspected signed unit-pivot Morse gradient recursion in verification/verify_desargues_character.py has five integer 5→4 coefficients all zero, yielding H4(Z)=Z and H5(Z)=Z5. An independent recreation corroborated face/Morse acyclicity and eight sample signed Lefschetz traces. Source verifies 240 automorphisms via fixed simplices AND orbit independence polynomials and gives reduced Lefschetz (−4,−4,0,−1,−1,−2,1) on S5 seven classes, reversing under complement. Any H4 action is sgn^a⊗epsilon^b; transposition and transposition×complement trace extremality force a=b=1, whence H5 char χ(p,c^s)=(-1)^s fixed_points(p), a Perm5⊗epsilon rational module. The central involution acts -I integrally on free H5 (order2, rational trace -5). No integral H5-module isomorphism claimed.
